decisions.reason: Area elastic sports flooring builds on established sports-floor expertise and serves a steady institutional market, though it sits outside the firm's residential trend focus.
The mobile arena floor is a niche, project-based product that still uses the firm's sports-floor know-how, but it may overlap with the parallel mobile system.
This second mobile arena system duplicates Product B, which raises consolidation risk, but there is not enough evidence to drop it now.
Chevron parquet is a strong design trend, was featured on the home page and fits the firm's residential strategy directly.
The squash court finish is a very small niche, but it is cheap to maintain alongside the sports-floor range.
Oak skirting is a low-cost accessory that supports sales of the sports-floor systems.
